data.name: Jignasha
data.gender_notes: Jignasha is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Jignasha means 'desire for knowledge' in Sanskrit. It is derived from the root word 'jigna' which means 'to know'. This name reflects a strong desire for knowledge and a thirst for wisdom. It is also associated with the moon, which represents the mind and the inner self. The name Jignasha carries the meaning “Desire for Knowledge” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Jignasha usually hope their child will grow to embody desire for knowledge and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Jignasha signifies the quest for knowledge and the inner light of wisdom. It is believed to bring enlightenment and self-realization. The name is also associated with the goddess Saraswati, the goddess of knowledge and wisdom.
data.etymology: Jignasha belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Desire for Knowledge.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jignasha total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
